categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Longtu Photomask Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor photomasks. The company focuses on high-precision photomasks used in semiconductor manufacturing, including quartz and soda-lime glass photomasks, serving sectors such as power semiconductors, MEMS sensors, IC packaging, and analog ICs. It is a rare independent third-party photomask manufacturer in China, targeting the domestic semiconductor industry with a focus on specialty process semiconductors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary technologies including CAM layout processing, optical proximity correction (OPC), precise alignment mark technology, phase shift mask (PSM) layout processing, electron beam lithography, dry etching, defect detection and repair, and exposure fine control. It has developed a comprehensive core technology system covering CAM, lithography, and inspection processes. Production methods include customized design and manufacturing of photomasks based on customer specifications, with full in-house capabilities from layout processing to cleaning and inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor wafer manufacturers, MEMS sensor producers, advanced packaging companies, and research institutions. The end markets served encompass new energy, photovoltaic power generation, automotive electronics, industrial control, wireless communication, IoT, and consumer electronics. The company has established stable relationships with major domestic wafer fabs and chip design companies, including Huahong, Chiplink, Silan Micro, Lianwei, Yandong Micro, and BYD Semiconductor.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and Zhuhai. It serves domestic customers extensively and has some sales to overseas markets, notably Taiwan. The company’s sales are predominantly domestic, with overseas sales accounting for a smaller portion but showing growth, especially from Taiwanese clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longtu Photomask operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a specialized photomask manufacturer. It provides critical photomask products that serve as pattern transfer tools in semiconductor wafer fabrication, linking chip design and wafer manufacturing. The company is positioned as an independent third-party supplier rather than an integrated wafer fab or chip designer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing semiconductor photomask technology to support domestic specialty and mature process nodes, aiming to expand from 130nm to 90nm and 65nm nodes and beyond. It emphasizes continuous R&D investment, innovation in photomask manufacturing processes, and development of third-generation PSM products. The company also prioritizes talent acquisition, process optimization, and expanding its product portfolio to meet evolving customer needs and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of customized semiconductor photomasks. The company adopts a direct sales model with some agency sales, especially for Taiwan customers. Pricing is based on product cost plus reasonable margins, adjusted for market competition and customer specifications. The company’s revenue depends on order-based production aligned with customer demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global photomask market is dominated by a few major international players such as Photronics (USA), Toppan and DNP (Japan), which control over 80% of the independent third-party market. Longtu Photomask is among the leading domestic independent third-party photomask manufacturers in China, with technology and production capabilities competitive at the 130nm node and actively developing more advanced nodes. It is positioned in the first tier domestically but faces a technology gap with global leaders at advanced nodes below 28nm.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 246.5 million, representing a 12.92% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 91.8 million, up 9.84%. Total assets and net assets more than doubled compared to the previous year, mainly due to the successful IPO and capital raising of RMB 553.46 million. The company’s R&D expenses increased by 14.25%, accounting for 9.35% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longtu Photomask emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive in-house manufacturing processes to deliver high-precision, customized photomasks. Its products support domestic semiconductor industry needs, enabling import substitution and reducing reliance on foreign suppliers. The company’s value proposition includes stable and high-quality product supply, advanced process compatibility, and responsive customer service, which together enhance customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
